payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison of the performance of a single-system approach versus system combination approaches in terms of word error rate (WER).

claims.text: The single-system approach achieved a WER of 41.6% on the DEV set and 43.2% on the EVAL set, which is a significant improvement over previous single-system results without system combination.

The best previous single-system results without system combination were 45.1% and 47.3% on the DEV and EVAL sets, respectively, indicating that the single-system approach is more effective than prior methods.
